depends_on.name: element_id
depends_on.documentation: The element (e.g. neuron) whose response was measured. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1).

depends_on.name: stimulator_id
depends_on.documentation: The stimulator element that delivered the stimulus -- T7's instrument role. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1) and set at +ndi/+app/+stimulus/tuning_response.m:328; V_eta had DROPPED it, so a migrated response could not say what stimulated the subject.

depends_on.name: stimulus_presentation_id
depends_on.documentation: The presentation this response was measured against. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1).

depends_on.name: stimulus_control_id
depends_on.documentation: The control this response is compared with. REQUIRED in NDI ("mustbenotempty": 1) and set at tuning_response.m:327; V_eta had DROPPED it. Left untyped: the control is another stimulus_response document and typing it rides with the stimulus model.

fields.name: stimulator_epochid
fields.documentation: Epoch identifier on the stimulator element whose presentation produced this response (e.g., 't00002'). Mirrors the v1 stimulus_response field.

fields.name: element_epochid
fields.documentation: Epoch identifier on the responding element (the element_id this document depends on) that aligns with the stimulator epoch above.
